title: Persist network lifecycle evidence
summary: Persist network lifecycle epoch and require backend reconciliation before fresh claims.
reason: Prevent a restarted backend from assuming a session-memory provider or claim is safe.
behavior_after: Persisted role state is reconciled through backend worker/claim evidence before a new start.
rollback_plan: Keep persisted state files and reconcile claims before reverting persistence behavior.
notes: Persisted network lifecycle epoch/state requires backend reconciliation before new claims.
